result.description: Financial data API: link bank accounts and fetch auth, balances, transactions, identity, investments, liabilities, income, and payments.
result.auth_detail: Per-team client_id plus per-environment secret, sent in the PLAID-CLIENT-ID and PLAID-SECRET headers or as body fields. End users connect banks through Plaid Link, which issues a per-Item access_token. Plaid itself does not offer OAuth2 for third-party apps. The Dashboard MCP server uses its own auth.
result.access_detail: Dashboard signup gives keys. Sandbox is always free. A US/Canada Free Trial makes live-data calls. Pay as You Go is $0/month with no minimum. Production access is requested in the Dashboard, and some products (e.g. Transfer) are not on Pay as You Go and are Custom-plan only. Production approval is a light gate but not instant for every product.
result.api_notes: JSON over HTTP. Products include Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities, Assets, Income, Enrich, Signal, Transfer, Identity Verification, Monitor, Layer, and more. Official SDKs exist for several languages. I did not verify the endpoint count; the product list comes from the pricing page.
result.blocker: The flow needs Plaid Link (a client-side UI) to get an access_token per end user, so a pure agent flow is awkward. Production access needs approval, and some products are plan-gated. The official MCP server is Dashboard diagnostics only, not data access, and needs Production approval.

evidence.quote: You'll need API keys, which you can receive by signing up in the Dashboard.
Our Free Trial allows you to make API calls using live data.
Month to month with no commitment. No caps on usage. Only pay for what you use.
The Plaid API is JSON over HTTP.
The **Dashboard MCP server** is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid.
Your team must be approved for Production access with at least one Plaid product to use the MCP server.
